description: Read-only source-review obligations grounded in the pinned checkout. Positive means the mechanism warrants this review, not an independently reproduced deployment vulnerability. No payloads or runtime tests are included.

cases.rootCause: Request data is embedded in authentication query structure.
cases.caveat: Authentication middleware and deployment conditions require source review; account-specific challenges share this operation.

cases.rootCause: Search data is embedded in database query structure.
cases.caveat: Distinct query operation from login, not one finding per returned data category.

cases.rootCause: Search input is promoted to trusted HTML.
cases.caveat: Read the linked template and relevant enforcement; a bypass API alone is not browser proof.

cases.rootCause: Requested object selection requires authenticated-principal binding.
cases.caveat: Authentication exists outside this function; ownership must be reviewed separately.

cases.rootCause: A fast unsalted hash is used by password storage.
cases.caveat: The model setter supplies the security-use context; not every non-password hash use is a defect.

cases.rootCause: Security-answer-based password reset requires review of answer trust and recovery policy.
cases.caveat: A correct HMAC comparison does not establish that the answer is a sufficient authentication factor.

cases.rootCause: Navigation depends on destination allowlist semantics.
cases.caveat: Review the helper and actual URL policy; historical techniques are not benchmark inputs.

cases.rootCause: File policy is checked before a filename transformation.
cases.caveat: Use production registration and exact checked/used values, not only a unit-test callback.

cases.rootCause: Quantity acceptance must preserve the downstream financial invariant.
cases.caveat: Read model constraints and checkout arithmetic before reaching a conclusion.

cases.rootCause: Encoded coupon data has authority-bearing consumption semantics.
cases.caveat: Review issuance, parsing and redemption together; encoding alone is not an integrity mechanism.

cases.rootCause: Coupon tool execution must enforce the business policy independently of prompt text.
cases.caveat: Current LLM implementation differs from older scripted-chat walkthroughs.

cases.rootCause: Ordinary Angular text interpolation is not an HTML trust bypass.
cases.caveat: Do not confuse the separate product-description HTML binding with review-message interpolation.

cases.rootCause: An old walkthrough discovers a hidden route through an HTML comment.
cases.caveat: This route is top-level data in the pinned version; route discovery alone is not a distinct confirmed vulnerability.
